structure.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.tooltip: A big floating island with a little lake, a waterfall and the cloud shepherd's hut. Rare!
structure.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.toolti: A half-collapsed little observatory on a high island. In the dark, extra many stars fall here.
structure.guhs.luchtballon_haven.tooltip: A jetty on the edge of an island with balloons. One ride a day down to the meadow.
block.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine_sterrenkaa: All the stars of the Guhmension, pricked out by hand.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.hallo: Nyeg! A visitor, all the way up here! I'm the cloud shepherd and these are my cloud lambs. Wahoog fluffy, nyeg? Shall I teach you how to turn fluff into a real cloud?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.later: Take it easy, chonk. The clouds won't run off. Well... a little.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap1: Lesson one: fluff! Snip one of my lambs with shears. It only tickles, and in a few minutes it's a little puffball again.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaar: Here, take my spare shears. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap1.nog: Snip first, chonk. Right-click a cloud lamb with the shears.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap2: Wahoog lovely fluff! Lesson two: put four tufts of cloud fluff in a square on a crafting table. That gives you cloud blocks. There's a crafting table in my hut.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap2.nog: Four tufts of fluff, two by two. Not enough? Snip another lamb, or wait until the fluff is back.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap3: A real cloud! Lesson three: build a little cloud staircase with it. Three cloud blocks, each one step higher than the last. That gets you anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap3.nog: Three cloud blocks going up at a slant, like little stairs. That's all it is.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap4: You could climb into the sky with that! Last lesson, and the most important one: resting. Sit on a cloud bench or snuggle into a cloud bed. They're right here by the hut.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.stap4.nog: Don't rush so, chonk. Sit on the cloud bench for a bit. It's part of the job.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.terug: Nice sit, nyeg? Come and see me for a moment.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.klaar: Nyeg! Now you're a real cloud maker. Here: some fluff to get started and a cloud lamp for your home. And if you like, you may take a lamb home with you.
gui.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.optie.schaapje: May I take a lamb home?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaapje: This is a sweet one. Hold the lead tight on the way back! It eats nibble feed and gives you fluff at home. Take wahoog good care of it, nyeg?
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.schaapje_al: You've already been given your lamb, chonk. Two lambs with nibble feed get a little one all by themselves.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.dag: Bye, chonk! Come snip some fluff again sometime.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje0: The lambs in the fold stay here, they belong to the island. But snipping fluff is always fine.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje1: Did you know a cloud block is soft? You can fall onto it from very high up. Nyeg, no harm done.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje2: The water from my little lake falls into a cloud. That's where the rain comes from, I think. Chonk.
quest.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.praatje3: The cloud lift takes you up and the cloud stream takes you back down. Just look at the little arrows.
gui.guhs.wolkenhoeder_hut.kudde_blijft: Nyeg! This lamb belongs to the cloud shepherd. Ask him for a lamb of your own.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.slaapt: Zzz... nyeg... zzz... five more little stars...
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.slaapt: The stargazer guh is asleep. Come back when it's dark.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.hallo: Oh... hello. Are you real, or am I dreaming you? It doesn't matter. Look up, chonk. They're all there again.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht0: Every star is a guh who once said "nyeg" very loudly. That's what I think. Wouldn't that be nice?
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht1: This little house used to have a whole roof. Then a star fell through it. Now I can see them better. Wahoog handy.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht2: Sometimes one falls. Then I make a wish. Mostly I wish for another star.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht3: Have a look through the telescope. If you're very quiet, the sky leaves a little stardust behind for you.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.nacht4: I sleep during the day. The sun is a star too, but she talks so loudly.
quest.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.stof: Shh... did you see that? A little stardust drifted past the lens. Hold out your hand.
gui.guhs.sterrenwacht_ruine.stof_al: You've already caught stardust here tonight. Again tomorrow night, nyeg.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.hallo: Ahoy, nyeg! Welcome to the Balloon Harbor. One ride a day, all the way down to the meadow below. Gently, with a view. All aboard?
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.vertrek: Hold on to the basket! Well, it goes wahoog slowly. Safe travels, chonk!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.al: You've already had your ride today, nyeg. The balloon needs a rest too. Again tomorrow!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.weg: The balloon is still on its way. A little patience, chonk, it'll be right back.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.geblokkeerd: Nyeg... there's no free spot to land down below right now. I don't dare. Try again in a bit.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.nee: No worries. Feel free to look around, the view is free.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.geland: Landed softly! The balloon floats back to the harbor by itself. See you tomorrow, nyeg!
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.terug: Nyeg, the landing spot was taken. We're back up. You keep today's ride.
quest.guhs.luchtballon_haven.afgebroken: Nyeg, the ride was cut short. You're back on the jetty and you keep today's ride.
gui.guhs.luchtballon_haven.blijf_zitten: Nyeg! Stay snug in the basket.
gui.guhs.luchtballon_haven.praat: Talk to the balloonist guh for a ride.
